# Example: Inserting Two Books With Same Bookcode

#### Course: Learn SQL Basics

## Example: Inserting Two Books With Same Bookcode

Let's try to insert two books, "The Great Gatsby" and "Harry Potter," with the same book_code, BC123.

```sql
1CREATE TABLE Books (
2    title VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
3    book_code VARCHAR(20) UNIQUE,
4    publisher VARCHAR(100)
5);
6
7INSERT INTO Books (title, book_code, publisher)
8VALUES ('The Great Gatsby', 'BC123', 'ABC Publishing');
9
10INSERT INTO Books (title, book_code, publisher)
11VALUES ('Harry Potter', 'BC123', 'XYZ Publishing');
```

The above query results in an error message.

Output

![Unique Constraint Error](data:image/png;base64,)

This error occurs because the UNIQUE constraint prevents duplicate values in the book_code column.
